Group Resource Delete Group
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/groups/:groupId

Deletes the group based on the specified ID.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
groupId
int32
REQUIRED

Group ID

Responses
​
204
403
404

Group deleted successfully
